column3: Close to the Hebrew; “until he cast them out” is rendered “till He finally cast them out.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “wall” (“the city wall was broken through”) and renders “the Arabah” as “the plain.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he spoke with him judgments” is rendered “he pronounced judgment on him.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the house of punishment” is rendered “prison.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he stood before the king of Babylon” is rendered “who served the king of Babylon.”
Close to the Hebrew; “and every house of the great” is rendered “that is, all the houses of the great.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who had fallen to the king of Babylon” is rendered “the defectors who had deserted to the king of Babylon.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the stands” is rendered “the carts.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the pans” is rendered “the spoons,” and NKJV supplies “the priests” as those who ministered.
Close to the Hebrew; “the pans” is rendered “the spoons,” and the second “bowls” “the cups.”
The Hebrew has “the twelve bronze bulls which were under the stands”; NKJV renders “which were under it, and the carts,” placing the bulls under the Sea.
Close to the Hebrew; “toward the side” (or “exposed”) is rendered “on the sides.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the priest of the head” is rendered “the chief priest.”

Close to the Hebrew; “a court official” is rendered “an officer,” “men who saw the king’s face” “the king’s close associates,” and “the scribe of the commander of the army” “the principal scribe of the army.”
